title: Pokemon TCG Coalossal Vivid Voltage 099/185 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Coalossal VMAX 099/185 Vivid Voltage Ultra Rare Holo Pokemon Card is a highly sought-after collectible card from the Pokémon TCG. This card features the powerful Coalossal character with an impressive 330 HP and VMAX stage, making it a valuable addition to any card collection. With its stunning full art design and ultra rare holo finish, this card is sure to stand out in any Pokémon card collection.
